Call.definition: One recorded conversation between a customer and a Representative, held as its Utterances in the order they were spoken.

Utterance.definition: One uninterrupted stretch of speech by one Speaker in a Call. Utterances are numbered from 1 in the order they were spoken.

Representative.definition: The bank employee who handles a Call.

Scorecard.definition: The list of Criteria that Calls of one kind are evaluated against, together with the pass mark an Evaluation has to reach.

Criterion.definition: One thing a Representative is expected to do on a Call, worded so that a Call either meets it or does not.

Evaluation.definition: The assessment of one Call against one Scorecard: exactly one Finding per Criterion, and the score, outcome and disposition that follow from them.

Finding.definition: The judgement of one Criterion for one Call: whether the Call met it, the Utterances cited in support and a short rationale.

Rejection.definition: The refusal to record a proposed Finding, or to complete an Evaluation, because it breaks a rule. It names the rule and says what would have been accepted, so that the proposer can correct itself.

call_id.definition: The unique identifier of a Call.

representative.definition: The Representative who handled a Call.

utterances.definition: The Utterances of a Call, in the order they were spoken.

sequence.definition: The position of an Utterance in its Call, counted from 1.

text.definition: The words of an Utterance, as transcribed.

representative_id.definition: The bank's identifier for a Representative.

scorecard_id.definition: The unique identifier of a Scorecard, including its version.

pass_mark.definition: The lowest score at which an Evaluation passes.

weight.definition: How much a Criterion counts towards the score, relative to the other Criteria of its Scorecard.

critical.definition: Whether failing this Criterion fails the whole Evaluation, whatever the score. Absent means false.

findings.definition: The Findings of an Evaluation, one per Criterion of its Scorecard.

score.definition: The weight of the Criteria a Call met, as a whole-number percentage of the weight of the Criteria that applied to it.

disposition.definition: Whether an Evaluation stands as it is or must be reviewed by a person first.

criterion.definition: The Criterion a Finding judges or a Rejection is about.

finding_outcome.definition: Whether the Call met the Criterion.

cited_utterances.definition: The sequence numbers of the Utterances a Finding relies on. In this context "evidence" is not used for them: in the workflow ontology Evidence means the result of a test run.

rationale.definition: One or two sentences on why a Finding has its outcome.

rejection_rule.definition: The rule a Rejection reports as broken.

detail.definition: What was wrong, in words the proposer can act on.

allowed_values.definition: The values that would have been accepted, where they form a closed set.

Speaker.CUSTOMER.definition: The person the bank is serving on the Call.

Speaker.SYSTEM.definition: A recorded announcement, such as the notice that the Call is recorded.

FindingOutcome.definition: The possible outcomes of a Finding.

FindingOutcome.NOT_MET.definition: The Criterion applied to the Call and the Call did not meet it.

FindingOutcome.NOT_APPLICABLE.definition: The Criterion did not apply to the Call. It counts neither for nor against the score.

EvaluationOutcome.definition: The possible outcomes of an Evaluation.

EvaluationOutcome.PASS.definition: The score reached the pass mark and no critical Criterion was failed.

EvaluationOutcome.FAIL.definition: The score is below the pass mark, or a critical Criterion was failed.

Disposition.definition: What happens to an Evaluation once it is complete.

Disposition.NEEDS_REVIEW.definition: A person must review the Evaluation before it is used.

RejectionRule.definition: The rules a proposed Finding or an Evaluation can break.

RejectionRule.MALFORMED_FINDING.definition: The proposal is not a well-formed Finding.

RejectionRule.UNKNOWN_CRITERION.definition: The Finding names a Criterion that is not in the Scorecard.

RejectionRule.DUPLICATE_FINDING.definition: A Finding for this Criterion has already been recorded.

RejectionRule.UNKNOWN_UTTERANCE.definition: The Finding cites an Utterance that is not in the Call.

RejectionRule.MISSING_CITATION.definition: The Finding is MET or NOT_MET and cites no Utterance.

RejectionRule.MISSING_FINDING.definition: A Criterion of the Scorecard has no Finding.
